from harbichess.replay.shard import read_shard
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/HarbiChess');run=root/'artifacts/ufuk-selfplay-20261003'
assert json.loads((run/'retention-generation-3.json').read_text())['status']=='pass'
meta=json.loads((run/'checkpoints/generation-000003/checkpoint.json').read_text());book=meta['run_config']['actor_openings']
held=json.loads((root/'docs/research/UFUK-selfplay-opening-splits-20261003.json').read_text())['splits']['arena'];heldkeys=set()
for row in held:
 b=chess.Board()
 for uci in row['opening']['moves']:b.push_uci(uci)
 heldkeys.add(' '.join(b.fen().split()[:4]))
audit={'status':'pass','games':0,'rows':0,'known_terminal_rows':0,'heldout_root_overlap':[],'validation_terminal_rows':{},'shards':{}};games={}
for path in sorted((run/'replay').glob('*.gz')):
 rules=PythonChessRules();s=read_shard(path,rules=rules)
 assert s.header.source_checkpoint==sha256(run/f'checkpoints/generation-{s.header.generation-1:06d}/model.safetensors')
 count=0
 for r in s.records:
  assert list(r.moves[:8])==book[r.game_index%48] and r.ply>=8
  board=rules.board(r.state);key=' '.join(board.fen().split()[:4])
  if key in heldkeys:audit['heldout_root_overlap'].append(key)
  games.setdefault(r.game_id,[]).append(r)
  audit['rows']+=1;audit['known_terminal_rows']+=r.outcome_value is not None;count+=r.outcome_value is not None
 audit['shards'][path.name]={'sha256':sha256(path),'payload_sha256':s.header.payload_sha256,'rows':len(s.records),'games':s.header.game_count}
 if 'validation' in path.name:audit['validation_terminal_rows'][path.name]=count

import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import random

import chess

root = pathlib.Path('/workspace/HarbiChess')
original = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-selfplay-arena-20261003'
verified = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-selfplay-arena-verified-20261003'
book = json.loads((root / 'docs/research/UFUK-selfplay-opening-splits-20261003.json').read_text())['splits']['arena']
digest = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
report = {'status': 'pass', 'original_games': 0, 'verified_games': 0, 'original_plies': 0, 'verified_plies': 0, 'matching_complete_histories': 0, 'arms': {}}
fields = ('opening_pair', 'opening', 'candidate_color', 'plies', 'termination', 'score', 'moves')
for name in ('vs-bootstrap', 'all-vs-stockfish32', 'bootstrap-vs-stockfish32'):
    paths = [directory / (name + '.json') for directory in (original, verified)]
    data = [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in paths]
    assert data[0]['summary'] == data[1]['summary']
    assert data[0]['candidate_sha256'] == data[1]['candidate_sha256']
    assert data[0]['opening_source_sha256'] == data[1]['opening_source_sha256']
    assert data[0]['evaluated_positions'] == data[1]['evaluated_positions']
    for kind, d in zip(('original', 'verified'), data):
        assert len(d['games']) == 48
        for i, g in enumerate(d['games']):
            assert g['opening_pair'] == i // 2
            expected = book[i // 2]['opening']['moves']
            assert g['opening'] == expected and g['moves'][:len(expected)] == expected
            assert g['candidate_color'] == ('white' if i % 2 == 0 else 'black')
            board = chess.Board()
            for uci in g['moves']:
                move = chess.Move.from_uci(uci)
                assert move in board.legal_moves
                board.push(move)
            assert board.ply() == g['plies']
            outcome = board.outcome(claim_draw=True)
            assert outcome is not None
            assert outcome.termination.name.lower() == g['termination']
            score = 0.5 if outcome.winner is None else float(outcome.winner == (g['candidate_color'] == 'white'))
            assert score == g['score']
            report[kind + '_games'] += 1
            report[kind + '_plies'] += len(g['moves'])
    for left, right in zip(data[0]['games'], data[1]['games'], strict=True):
        assert all(left[k] == right[k] for k in fields)
        report['matching_complete_histories'] += 1
    report['arms'][name] = {'original_sha256': digest(paths[0]), 'verified_sha256': digest(paths[1]), 'summary': data[0]['summary'], 'original_wall_seconds': data[0]['wall_seconds'], 'verified_wall_seconds': data[1]['wall_seconds'], 'evaluated_positions': data[0]['evaluated_positions']}
candidate = data = json.loads((original / 'all-vs-stockfish32.json').read_text())
control = json.loads((original / 'bootstrap-vs-stockfish32.json').read_text())
differences = [a - b for a, b in zip(candidate['summary']['pair_scores'], control['summary']['pair_scores'], strict=True)]
rng = random.Random(20261006)
samples = sorted(sum(rng.choices(differences, k=24)) / 24 for _ in range(10000))
report['sf32_paired_score_delta'] = {'mean': sum(differences) / 24, 'pair_differences': differences, 'conditional_bootstrap_95': [samples[249], samples[9749]]}
report['scope'] = 'Source-integrity reproduction, not another strength sample. All original scores retained. Same 24 reused development families/fresh roots; no general Elo. Automatic claim_draw; actual SF nodes unrecorded, sim/node unequal.'
p = original / 'arena-provenance-audit.json'
assert not p.exists()
p.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
